applicability: Operations Desk evidence edition 6.4. Applies to source evidence and commercial payment responsibility.
content:
# Commercial records and payment instructions

These terms apply to the Operations Desk evidence edition 6.4. Bank object IDs identify records; commercial_reference identifies correspondence about the underlying business. The business_documents resource holds received third-party documents, with kind, reference, issuer, issued_minute, status and body. Search by the business reference or document kind. It contains source statements, not an eligibility decision or an approval of a proposed allocation.

Purchase order numbers are unique only within a buyer and invoice period. buyer_payment_terms identifies the payer, currency, invoice month and purchase orders covered by a remittance. A payer_letter states exact amounts only for its expressly designated orders; an omitted order is not an instruction to assign zero. Invoice IDs are internal and do not appear in payer letters. A historical paid invoice can carry the same purchase order number as a current invoice. A supplier_invoice identifies its bill-to party by registration number. The entities register connects that number to the legal account holder. Bank mandates list authorized payers; they do not determine the commercial bill-to party.

warehouse_receipt describes quantities ordered, accepted and returned and the unit price for a shipment. Accepted units exclude returned units. Uncompensated goods value is (ordered_units - accepted_units) times unit_price_minor, less settled compensation for the same shipment. returned_units is included in the unaccepted quantity and must not be added a second time. A bank compensation memo identifies a shipment_reference and retains its actual payment status. A provisional credit is not a final receipt. Shipment references must be matched within the same purchase case.

collection_product_terms is an institution-issued product schedule: registration_regions, settlement_markets, merchant_categories, payment_networks and new_issuance apply to the product with the matching reference. Account-opening fees and balances remain in bank records. A successful opening consumes its published fee and issuance credit even when its coverage is unsuitable for the customer's other sites.

proceeds_assignment states the commercial uses of received proceeds. bank_permitted_purposes lists the institution's legal payment categories. A bank may execute a payment that is within those categories but breaches the proceeds assignment. Bank restrictions, unreleased rights, access permissions and available balances are still enforced. Executed purpose payments are final within this service: their amounts cannot be recalled, redirected or replenished by relabeling the source. Such a receipt confirms movement of money, not conformity with its commercial assignment.

facility_covenant describes a reserve drawing's release milestones using commercial references. A receivables file closure means the corresponding file is CLOSED; institutional application approval means APPROVED; operational collection service means COLLECTING. A settled obligation payment means the aggregate SETTLED payments for that commercial obligation in its stated currency. Other covenant types are received batch payment (distinct successful bank attempt receipts), tax filing discharge (DISCHARGED), settled dispute compensation (SETTLED network compensation), and future subscription billing destination (the effective billing account for that service). These business events are distinct from submission acknowledgements. A covenant refers to business records; it does not identify a recommended drawing or the order of other work.
provenance_note: Synthetic normalization of documentary evidence; amounts remain those of the parent scenarios.
title: Commercial source records and bank payment responsibility
